files.berth-terms.md:
# Eastcliff Boatyard - winter berth terms

These terms were revised on 1 September 2026 and apply to the whole winter season.

## 1. Booking
Berths are held once a deposit of 25 per cent of the season charge is received.

## 2. Cancellation
Notice of cancellation must reach the office in writing at least 10 days before the lift-in date. Where that notice is given, the deposit is returned in full.

## 3. Ashore storage
Mast-up storage is charged per metre of overall length.

## 4. Cover
Every berth holder holds third-party cover of at least 2,000,000 for the season.
files.harbour-notes.md:
# Whitcombe Harbour notes

Lift-in for the winter fleet begins on 3 November 2026.
The fuel dock is open daily from 08:00.
Berth holders may book the scrubbing grid on weekdays.
